FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'la fille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the baby
   C. the boy
   D. the girl

2. What does 'le garçon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the child
   C. the grandmother
   D. the boy

3. What does 'la fenêtre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the book
   B. the window
   C. the cat
   D. the bed

4. What does 'le chat' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the cat
   B. the table
   C. the chair
   D. the fridge

5. How do you say 'Here is my house.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Où est le chat ?
   B. Voici ma maison.
   C. C'est un lit.
   D. C'est une table.

6. How do you say 'On Thursday, I sing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   B. Une semaine, sept jours.
   C. Le jeudi, je chante.
   D. Le vendredi, je danse.

7. What does 'demain' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. I rest
   C. I play
   D. I dance

8. Which month is 'février'? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. April
   C. February
   D. May

9. How do you say 'When is your birthday?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai neuf ans.
   B. Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   C. Merci beaucoup !
   D. Bon anniversaire !

10. What number is 'trois' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 25

11. How do you say 'They are mangoes.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je bois un jus.
   B. C'est une banane.
   C. Ce sont des mangues.
   D. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.

12. How do you say 'In the morning, I eat bread.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   B. Je bois un jus.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. Le matin, je mange du pain.

13. How do you say 'I like the mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'aime la mangue.
   B. Je bois un jus.
   C. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   D. Je n'aime pas le poisson.

14. What does 'l'épaule' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the stomach
   B. the nose
   C. the tooth
   D. the shoulder

15. How do you say 'I have two ears.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai dix doigts.
   B. Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   C. J'ai deux oreilles.
   D. Touche ton nez !

16. What does 'noir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tall, big
   B. black
   C. long
   D. short

17. Read: Amina: Excusez-moi, où est l'école ? Kamau: Allez tout droit. Tournez à gauche. Amina: Merci ! Kamau: De rien ! Question: What does Amina want to find? (1 mark)
   A. the house
   B. the shop
   C. the church
   D. the school

18. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: How many brothers and sisters does Amina have in total? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 4

19. What does 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   B. It is a table.
   C. Put the book in the bedroom.
   D. The cat is under the chair.

20. Which little word goes with 'maison' (the house)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

21. Which little word goes with 'sac' (the bag)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

22. Which little word goes with 'fête'? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. l'
   D. la

23. What does 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a banana.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. What is it?
   D. It is a cake.

24. What does 'J'aime le lait.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. They are mangoes.
   D. I like milk.

25. What does 'Il neige.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is snowing.
   B. It is cold.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. I stay in the house.

26. What does 'Il fait chaud.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is cloudy.
   B. It is hot.
   C. What is the weather like?
   D. I stay in the house.

27. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: Where does the speaker not go? (1 mark)
   A. to school
   B. into the house
   C. under a big tree
   D. to the shop

28. What does 'Tournez à gauche.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Go straight ahead.
   B. The door is next to the window.
   C. Turn left.
   D. You are welcome!

29. How do you say 'well' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Madame
   B. bonjour
   C. bien
   D. oui

30. How do you say 'It is, this is' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la fille
   B. la grand-mère
   C. C'est
   D. le père

31. How do you say 'the living room' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la cuisine
   B. le ballon
   C. la chambre
   D. le salon

32. How do you say 'yesterday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. hier
   C. je danse
   D. demain

33. How do you write the number 16 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. seize
   C. quatorze
   D. huit

34. How do you say the month 'October' in French? (1 mark)
   A. octobre
   B. mars
   C. août
   D. juin

35. How do you say 'a balloon' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une bougie
   B. une chanson
   C. un gâteau
   D. un ballon

36. How do you say 'maize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les bonbons
   B. la mangue
   C. les frites
   D. le maïs

37. How do you say 'juice' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les fruits
   B. le thé
   C. les frites
   D. le jus

38. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'health'? (1 mark)
   A. santè
   B. santé
   C. sante
   D. saté

39. How do you say 'It is freezing.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il pleut.
   B. Il y a des nuages.
   C. Il y a du vent.
   D. Il gèle.

40. How do you say 'next to' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à gauche
   B. à droite
   C. tout droit
   D. à côté de

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into English: 'Il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'Here is a present for you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'The fridge is in the kitchen.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Il y a du soleil.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'It is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'The cat is under the chair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'On Thursday, I sing.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I go to church.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into English: 'Il fait chaud.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: 'Demain, il fait beau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Write five parts of the body in French with le, la or les. (5 marks) (5 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux pieds.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

55. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

56. Translate into French: 'How old are you?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'I have two ears.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into French: 'My mother is called Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Write in French: your birthday is on 25 December. (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Write three sentences in French about what you eat in a day. (3 marks) (3 marks)

61. Translate into English: 'Mon père s'appelle David.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
